cells.gaps: No body is named to check compliance with the instruction or grant exemptions from it; no organisation is named as ordered, penalised or exempted under it.
cells.note: The Prime Minister's instruction of 23 January 2026 that public platforms and data held by private hosts or abroad be brought back to the two government datacentres is a duty on public bodies to host in a named data centre in the country, so stage 3. No enforcer is named, so not stage 4.
